## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very narrow sector breadth with Energy and Financials positive while mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) are broadly BELOW TREND — paired signals warrant caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +17.38%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND. Financials also showing pockets of strength: C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY; Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND, WELL (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples and Technology lag: EL (1W: -19.60% | 1M: -36.56%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: SLB (1W: +9.49% | 1M: -1.42%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +17.38%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (Energy concentration but Top 5 span 3 sectors).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -7.08% | 1M: +9.07%) CORRECTION, UL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND, WELL (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Real Estate/Consumer Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: SLB (1W: +9.49% | 1M: -1.42%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flag: JPM (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: -3.70% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION show 1W/1M mismatches — tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech broadly weak with concentrated semiconductor strength. Key names: AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND; pockets: AMD (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.46% | 1M: -1.30%) RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing relative resilience but mixed internals. C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive for now; style: Value/Cyclical favored given Energy + Financial leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure and acting defensive despite select positive news. JNJ (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.79%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -2.94% | 1M: -14.69%) BELOW TREND; catalyst-driven names (BMY/MDT) exist but not shifting sector internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Financials (PSX, XOM, C) given breadth concentration; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech megacaps showing broad BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth; exercise position sizing caution due to narrow internal leadership and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -19.60% | 1M: -36.56%) BELOW TREND — watch legal/merger headlines for follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +14.24%) — clear leadership; Financials (1W: +0.94% | 1M: -3.32%) — selective strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.71% | 1M: +0.31%) and Real Estate (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -6.50%) — watch for further dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for any weekly reversal to arrest 1M (-8.53%) slide to shift from BELOW TREND; AAPL: failure to close weekly above recent short-term range would keep it BELOW TREND (1M: -5.46%); XOM: sustained weekly gains that keep 1M > +8% would confirm continuation ABOVE TREND; JPM: sustained weekly follow-through above recent RECOVERY move (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -1.77%) would signal broader Financial participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+60): JNJ advances bladder cancer treatment; price JNJ (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.79%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet confirmed by price. NVDA (+55): CEO comments on AGI; NVDA (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price. JPM (+55): regulatory relief headlines; JPM (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short-term strength. EL (+80): merger talks; EL (1W: -19.60% | 1M: -36.56%) BELOW TREND — strong sentiment but clear distribution/delisting risk to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-75): DOJ antitrust probe; UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. AMD (-45): Arm competition headline; AMD (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through. (Only UNH and AMD from the bearish list have full timeframe data here; UNH confirms the negative catalyst while AMD is a divergence.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION — Value/Cyclical style. PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND and C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: mega-cap Tech cluster remains BELOW TREND and major divergences (JPM/AMZN/MA mixed 1W vs 1M) plus UNH (-75 sentiment) and EL (bullish news but steep price selloff) warrant caution.
